reviews.title: It does well all you need to know, if ram wasn’t so expensive I would’ve bought another one.
reviews.comment: After 3 months of use this ram has had no problems running, I ran local ai’s and played multiple video games with it (basically an unknow stress test for me and it did fantastic) the height of ram fits perfectly with an air cooler has you can see in the photos. No complaints it does its job, the pricing is a little insane but I got it 3 months ago with cash back, so I got it for 250 I think.
reviews.author: Frankie

reviews.title: Well priced for what it delivers, and works!
reviews.comment: Glad I purchased this before the RAM shortage/price increase hit. Was not concerned with RGB or my PC having a color profile, just needed reliability and something that delivers. KLEVV is reliable is decently priced, so I purchased two 16GB sticks. No issues with installing them when I was building my PC, and performance delivers. Would recommend!
reviews.author: Isaac M

reviews.title: Works perfectly, stats seem great
reviews.comment: From reading the comments and the information included in the packaging it seems as though this chip punches above its price point. It has worked perfectly for me. Starts out at 4200 and with XMP or whatever enabled in the bios goes straight up to 6000 cl30 without any issues. Minimalistic dark gray look. No regrets
reviews.author: Mike g

reviews.title: Worth it.
reviews.comment: Great ram. Binned well, OCs very high with tight timings. Running it with my 9800x3D - has low latency with EXPO timings. Easily took Buildzoid’s basic OC timings with no issues. I’d love to buy more, but will need my kidney to grow back so I can sell it again. Thanks data-centers and ai-influencers! The world is so much better off and more productive, and definitely so much more fun, since y’all started using all of the available ram to make high tech chat bots.
reviews.author: Max
